title: Enhancing Business Central with Address Validation AI
summary: Address validation using Azure OpenAI compares user-entered addresses against existing Business Central address records to identify matches and preserve associated metadata. The solution uses a system prompt to guide AI in matching addresses semantically rather than character-by-character, returning match confidence scores.
key_points: Free-text ship-to addresses lose extra data tied to stored Business Central addresses, such as salesperson or regional details, so matching to an existing address code helps keep it
The user address and the customer's known addresses are sent as JSON to Azure OpenAI, which returns a match score between 0 and 1 for each address
The system prompt carries the logic: ignore abbreviation and line-order differences, and treat a state mismatch as strongly non-matching
In a test, a near-identical address scored 1, while the same street in Atlanta GA versus Atlanta TX scored 0.6, low enough to reject but high enough to flag for review
The author's earlier rule-based approach using USPS CASS, Levenshtein distance and hard-coded rules only reached about 70% accuracy
